prompt:
The graph below shows the percentage of household waste that was recycled in three towns between 1995 and 2020.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
instruction_line: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task. Write at least 150 words.

visual.title: Household waste recycled in three towns, 1995-2020
visual.alt: A line graph showing the change in the percentage of household waste recycled in three towns between 1995 and 2020.

key_points: Marden and Trentbury both rise throughout the period, while Hallowfield is the only town to fall
Trentbury starts at the lowest figure (8%) and ends at the highest (61%) — the fastest rise
Hallowfield starts as the highest in 1995 (30%) but falls to the lowest by 2020 (20%)
Both rising towns overtake Hallowfield between 2005 and 2010; Trentbury also overtakes Marden in the same period
The gap between the towns widens from 22 percentage points in 1995 to 41 percentage points in 2020
common_mistakes: Giving an opinion or inventing reasons ('the council should…', 'because people became greener') — this task must not go beyond the data
Reading through all six years one by one instead of giving the overall trend and the point where lines cross
Confusing percentage with 'amount' ('the amount of waste rose' — the graph gives a proportion)
